# Peterson Clinic

> Peterson Clinic is an integrative chiropractic and naturopathic clinic in Hermiston, OR specializing in musculoskeletal care, neurology, internal medicine, and mind-body healing techniques.

Founded by Dr. Kristopher B Peterson (DC, DABCI), Peterson Clinic combines chiropractic expertise with integrative medicine, offering specialized services including sports injury treatment, neurological care, and advanced therapies like cold laser, shockwave therapy, and NeuroEmotional Technique. The clinic operates under the Triangle of Health paradigm to address structural, chemical, and emotional wellness.

## Core Services & Treatment Specialties

- [Musculoskeletal](https://www.petersonclinic.com/musculoskeletal): Musculoskeletal and sports injury treatment with Dr Trent using Activator and Cold Laser Therapy.
- [Internal/Integrative Medicine](https://www.petersonclinic.com/internal-integrative-medicine): Internal medicine and integrative care by Dr Kris Peterson and Dr Anton Alder for chronic disease.
- [Neurology](https://www.petersonclinic.com/neurology): Neurology services including dementia, Parkinson's, and concussion care by Drs Kris and Trent.
- [NeuroEmotional Technique (NET)](https://www.petersonclinic.com/neuroemotional-technique-net): NeuroEmotional Technique for stress, trauma, and mind-body healing with Dr Kris.
- [Shockwave Therapy](https://www.petersonclinic.com/services-6): FDA-approved Shockwave Therapy for plantar fasciitis, tennis elbow, and musculoskeletal pain.
- [Sleep Apnea & Snoring Treatment](https://www.petersonclinic.com/neuroemotional-technique-net-copy): Fotona Nightlase C3 laser therapy for sleep apnea and snoring treatment.
